title: クライマックス1戦目の後に

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That was a spectacular race! Truly fit for a "climax"!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However! The road to greatness still stretches out far ahead!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hence the aggressive encouragement! I sincerely hope that <chrname> races valiantly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right. For better or worse, there are still two rounds to go! We can't let our guard down yet!
